c92a503eabc2be2c.text: LLM-based simulations of social media conversations are increasingly used to examine phenomena such as opinion dynamics and polarization. However, the naturalness of such synthetic conversations lacks comprehensive evaluation, limiting our ability to assess whether they mimic real conversations and support valid inferences. This paper proposes a multi-dimensional, multi-level framework for evaluating such naturalness across three complementary dimensions i.e., lexical, dialog, and semantic, at the word/ sentence, interaction, and thread levels, with five pre-registered metrics. We apply the framework to Reddit-style synthetic conversations across several topics that we generate with a base model and a fine-tuned Llama3.3 model. We validate the metrics’ rankings against human evaluations for a popular topic. The results show that fine-tuning improves performance across all three dimensions, with the automated metric rankings broadly aligned with human judgments. This study contributes towards a holistic evaluation framework for assessing the naturalness of synthetic social media conversations that can be extended to other synthetic dialog data.
c92a503eabc2be2c.abstract_zh: 用大模型模拟社交媒体对话来研究舆论动态和极化等现象的做法越来越多，但这些合成对话到底像不像真实对话，一直缺少系统的评估，这限制了从中得出有效推断的可靠性。论文提出了一个多维、多层的自然度评估框架，从词汇、对话、语义三个互补维度出发，分别在词句、交互和帖子串三个层级上衡量，并定义了五个预注册指标。作者用基础模型和微调过的 Llama3.3 在多个话题上生成 Reddit 风格的合成对话，再用框架打分。对一个热门话题，作者把指标给出的排序与人类评估做了对照验证。结果显示，微调在三个维度上都有改进，自动指标的排序与人类判断大体一致。作者认为这个框架可用于评估合成社交媒体对话的自然度，并可扩展到其他合成对话数据。局限方面，材料只提到对一个热门话题做了人类评估验证，未涉及更多话题或真实数据的直接校准。
c92a503eabc2be2c.why: 它直接回应了 LLM 社会仿真的可信度问题，给出了一套可复用的自然度评估指标，且指标排序经过人类评估对照，做舆论仿真的人可以拿它来检验自己生成的对话数据。

brief.question: LLM 生成的社交媒体合成对话（如用于观点动力学和极化研究的 Reddit 风格对话）是否自然、能否支持有效推断，此前缺乏系统评估，本文提出并检验一套自然度评估框架。
brief.setup: 针对 Reddit 风格的合成对话，覆盖多个话题，用基座模型和微调后的 Llama3.3 生成对话，具体智能体数量、环境与时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 提出多维多层级评估框架：词汇、对话、语义三个维度，分别在词/句、交互、帖子串三个层级上评估，使用五个预注册指标。
brief.findings: 微调后的 Llama3.3 在三个维度上均优于基座模型；自动指标对合成对话的排序与人类评估基本一致。
brief.validation: 在一个热门话题上，将自动指标的排序与人类评估对比，二者大体吻合；未说明误差数值或其他话题的验证。
brief.limits: 验证只覆盖一个热门话题；框架能否推广到其他合成对话数据，材料中仅称可扩展但未给出实验；未说明样本量。
brief.reuse: 可直接借鉴其三维度三层级、含五个预注册指标的评估框架，用于评估其他合成对话数据的自然度；代码和数据未说明是否公开。

c5fad41f7b61d2ec.text: Activision专利申请披露：AI系统学习玩家聊天内容，为NPC生成语音 Mezha.net
c5fad41f7b61d2ec.abstract_zh: 据 Mezha.net 报道，动视（Activision）提交的一项专利申请披露了一套 AI 系统，它通过学习玩家在游戏中的聊天内容，为 NPC 生成语音。材料只有标题和一句话描述，没有说明系统的具体架构、用了什么模型、如何生成语音，也没有任何实验结果或落地信息。从专利申请这一形式看，这属于技术方案披露，不代表产品已经上线。

c0a18809d198e887.text: Operations research (OR) relies on algorithms that experts tailor to each problem: a new routing, scheduling or network design problem can take weeks of specialist work before it is solved well at scale. Large language model (LLM) agents now write, test and improve code, but whether they can design algorithms that scale to realistic instances is open: in the FrontierOR benchmark's one-shot evaluation, the strongest model matches Gurobi, with an objective within 1% of Gurobi's and no slower, on only 39% of the large instances. The FrontierOR Challenge asks teams to build agentic workflows that design, test, and improve algorithms for many optimization problems at once. Stage 1 releases 60 of the benchmark's 180 audited problems, spanning six application categories and five formulation types, in weekly rounds of 15; Stage 2 introduces new problems outside the benchmark, with unseen instances. Two tracks are ranked separately: in the Main track we run the submitted algorithms in a network-isolated sandbox with open-source dependencies only; in the Self-hosted track teams solve the instances on their own machines, with any software, within a timed window. Every solution is checked for feasibility, and a feasible solution scores the ratio of its objective to a frozen known reference, averaged over hidden instances.
c0a18809d198e887.abstract_zh:
运筹优化问题通常需要专家针对每个具体问题手工定制算法，一个新的路径规划、调度或网络设计问题往往要花数周专家工作才能在大规模实例上求解得好。大模型智能体已经能写代码、测试和迭代改进，但能否设计出可扩展到真实规模实例的算法仍是开放问题。作者用 FrontierOR 基准做了一次性评测：最强的模型只在 39% 的大实例上追平 Gurobi，即目标值与 Gurobi 相差不超过 1% 且运行速度不更慢。

基于这个缺口，FrontierOR 挑战赛要求队伍构建智能体工作流，同时为多个优化问题设计、测试和改进算法。第一阶段分周发布基准 180 个审计问题中的 60 个，覆盖六类应用场景和五种建模类型，每周 15 个；第二阶段引入基准之外的新问题和未见过的实例。比赛设两条赛道分别排名：主赛道在仅允许开源依赖的网络隔离沙盒中运行提交的算法；自托管赛道允许队伍在自己的机器上用任意软件在限时窗口内求解。每个解都会检查可行性，可行解的得分是其目标值与一个冻结的已知参考值之比，在隐藏实例上取平均。
c0a18809d198e887.why: 它给出了一个直接可用的评测基准和竞赛设计，量化了当前 LLM 智能体在运筹算法设计上与商业求解器 Gurobi 的真实差距，沙盒隔离和隐藏实例的评分协议也可复用到其他智能体能力评测里。

brief.question: LLM 智能体能否设计出可扩展到真实规模实例的运筹优化算法，替代专家数周的定制工作。
brief.setup: FrontierOR Challenge 竞赛设定：Stage 1 分周发布 180 个审计问题中的 60 个，覆盖六类应用和五种建模类型，每周 15 题；Stage 2 引入基准外的新问题和新实例。设 Main 和 Self-hosted 两个赛道，前者在网络隔离沙盒中仅用开源依赖运行提交的算法，后者允许参赛者用任意软件在限时内自解实例。
brief.method: 参赛队伍构建 agentic workflow，同时为多个优化问题设计、测试并改进算法。
brief.findings: 基线方面，FrontierOR 一次性评测中最强模型在大实例上仅 39% 能达到 Gurobi 水平（目标值差距 1% 以内且不更慢）。评分方式为可行解的目标值与冻结参考解之比，在隐藏实例上取平均。
brief.validation: 每个解都做可行性检查，并与冻结的已知参考解比较目标值；未说明与真实世界数据的进一步验证。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: Stage 1 的 60 个审计问题（含六类应用、五种建模类型）可作为公开基准数据直接使用。

c2e5f6a5bcc1a417.text: Abstract TRACE-Bench is a reproducible benchmark for studying how errors in e-commerce metadata affect supplier screening, product catalogue management and digital service selection. It evaluates TRACE, a multi-agent framework that matches records by identifier, weighs conflicting values according to source reliability and records the evidence behind each recommendation. When the evidence is uncertain, TRACE can request a second check or refer the case for human review. Across 1,000 Monte Carlo replications on synthetic data, each method evaluated 450,000 cases. The rate of incorrect recommendations was 4.4% for TRACE, 7.6% for simulated manual review, 20.1% for a simulated single agent based on a large language model and 32.4% for conventional automated search. TRACE approved 1.5% of ineligible cases and referred 18.6% of all cases for human review. Description The Python package generates synthetic records with known attribute values and eligibility status. Researchers can vary how often sources contain outdated information, records for entities with similar names, or instructions embedded in retrieved content. Five variants of TRACE each omit one component, allowing researchers to measure its contribution to decision accuracy and human review workload. The archive includes the source code, experiment settings, replication-level CSV results, summary tables with 95% confidence intervals, paired statistical tests and a worked supplier-screening example. It also includes Figures 1–8 from the companion manuscript and the scripts used to generate them. The Jupyter notebook supports a short demonstration, reproduction of the full experiment and inspection of the archived results. The code is released under the MIT License. The archived results, figures and saved notebook outputs are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Keywords Artificial intelligence agents, metadata verification, e-commerce, data provenance, entity resolution, decision support, human oversight, Monte Carlo simulation.
c2e5f6a5bcc1a417.abstract_zh:
电商场景里，供应商筛选、商品目录管理和服务选择都依赖元数据，而元数据里的错误会直接影响决策。TRACE-Bench 就是为研究这类错误影响而做的可复现基准，发布在 Zenodo 上，包含 Python 源码、实验设置、每次复现的 CSV 结果、带 95% 置信区间的汇总表、配对统计检验，以及一个完整的供应商筛选示例，还附了论文里的图 1 到图 8 和生成这些图的脚本。代码采用 MIT 许可证，归档结果和图表采用 CC BY 4.0。

被评测的 TRACE 是一个多智能体框架。它按标识符匹配记录，根据来源可靠性给冲突的取值加权，并记录每条推荐背后的证据。证据不确定时，TRACE 可以要求二次核查，或者把案例转交人工审核。基准用 Python 包生成已知属性值和资格状态的合成记录，研究者可以调节来源信息过时的频率、名称相近实体的记录数量，以及检索内容中嵌入的指令（即提示注入类干扰）。基准还提供五个消融版本的 TRACE，每个去掉一个组件，用来衡量各组件对决策准确率和人工审核工作量的贡献。

实验在合成数据上做了 1000 次蒙特卡洛复现，每种方法各评估 45 万条案例。错误推荐率方面，TRACE 为 4.4%，模拟人工审核为 7.6%，基于大语言模型的模拟单智能体为 20.1%，常规自动搜索为 32.4%。TRACE 批准了 1.5% 的不合格案例，并把全部案例中的 18.6% 转交人工复核。

需要说明的是，这些结果全部基于合成数据，尚未与真实电商数据对照验证。
c2e5f6a5bcc1a417.why: 它提供了一个完整开源、可复现的仿真基准，把提示注入、来源过时、名称混淆等干扰因素做成可调参数，并带消融实验设计，适合做智能体决策可信度和人机分工研究的实验底座。

brief.question: 电商元数据出错时，如何评估其对供应商筛选、商品目录管理和服务选择的影响，并验证多智能体框架 TRACE 在元数据发现与核验上的表现。
brief.setup: 在合成数据上做 1,000 次 Monte Carlo 复现，每种方法评估 450,000 个案例。对比四种方法：TRACE 多智能体框架、模拟人工审核、基于大语言模型的单一智能体、传统自动搜索。
brief.method: TRACE 按标识符匹配记录，根据来源可靠性权衡冲突值，并记录每条推荐背后的证据。证据不确定时可请求二次核查或转人工审核。Python 包可生成已知属性值和资格状态的合成记录，并允许调整来源过时频率、同名实体记录和检索内容中嵌入的指令。提供五个 TRACE 变体，各去掉一个组件用于消融。
brief.findings: 错误推荐率 TRACE 为 4.4%，模拟人工审核 7.6%，LLM 单智能体 20.1%，传统自动搜索 32.4%。TRACE 批准了 1.5% 的不合格案例，并把 18.6% 的案例转人工审核。
brief.validation: 在 1,000 次 Monte Carlo 复现的合成数据上评估，提供 95% 置信区间、配对统计检验和五组件消融实验。因数据为合成，未与真实电商数据对比，材料未说明外部验证。
brief.limits: 全部基于合成数据，结论能否迁移到真实电商元数据场景材料未说明。TRACE 转人工审核的比例达 18.6%，人工负担不小。
brief.reuse: 归档包含源代码（MIT License）、实验设置、复现级 CSV 结果、汇总表、统计检验脚本、供应商筛选示例、论文图 1–8 及生成脚本，还有可复现完整实验的 Jupyter notebook，结果按 CC BY 4.0 开放。

ceb19a347eba9138.text: “硅基社区”有多强？国内首个社会政策模拟仿真智能体落地赤峰 新浪财经
ceb19a347eba9138.abstract_zh: 材料是一条来自新浪财经、经 Google 新闻聚合的中文报道，标题为“‘硅基社区’有多强？国内首个社会政策模拟仿真智能体落地赤峰”。报道指出，名为“硅基社区”的社会政策模拟仿真智能体已在内蒙古赤峰市落地，并称其为国内首个此类智能体。材料正文只有标题本身，没有提供该智能体的技术方案、模拟内容、验证结果或落地效果等细节，无法进一步核实其具体做法与成效。
ceb19a347eba9138.why: 它标记了国内首个声称落地真实城市的社会政策模拟仿真智能体，关注政策推演落地的人可以留意后续是否有技术细节和效果数据披露。
ceb19a347eba9138.story: 名为“硅基社区”的社会政策模拟仿真智能体在内蒙古赤峰落地，凤凰网和新浪财经都报道了这件事，并称其为国内首个此类应用。两家来源目前只给出标题，没有提供技术细节、仿真结果或验证数据，报道时间均为 2026 年 11 月 11 日。从现有信息看，这件事说明国内开始把智能体仿真用于社会政策推演，并有地方落地案例，但“国内首个”的说法和实际效果都还缺少可核查的细节支撑，后续需要更多技术资料和验证数据才能判断其真实水平。

ca29e3bae1447b07.text: 多伦多大学团队提出“自建实验室”：AI自主构建数字孪生，完成真实化学实验 麻省理工科技评论
ca29e3bae1447b07.abstract_zh: 材料仅是一条新闻标题：多伦多大学团队提出“自建实验室”，让 AI 自主构建数字孪生，并完成真实化学实验，报道来自麻省理工科技评论。标题之外没有给出方法、实验设置、结果数字或验证方式的任何细节，无法进一步转述。
ca29e3bae1447b07.why: 标题指向 AI 自主搭建数字孪生并对接真实实验的路线，对做仿真与沙盒环境的研究者可能是一个新的环境构建思路，但需要读原文确认细节。

c17bea1790859202.text: The bitter lesson holds that general methods leveraging computation defeat hand-encoded domain knowledge. We argue it carries a condition its popular reading omits: in every case Sutton cites, the general method was scaled against the same task the domain engineering was solving. Social simulation substituted across tasks instead, replacing hand-built agents with an artifact optimized for predicting text. The move is bitter-lesson-shaped, but the lesson does not license it. Prediction is a solitary act: the predictor bears no consequences from the interaction it models. Cooperation, defection, and norm enforcement are phenomena of interested parties; they do not exist for a disinterested observer at any scale. What is missing is not emergence, which LLM populations already show, but stakes. We show that several anomalies reported in prior work (excess cooperation that predates alignment training, collective agreement without individual fidelity, and population homogeneity) follow from this account. A 540-agent pilot with pre-specified hypotheses, which tests sensitivity to persistent consequences rather than cooperation, finds that consequences reshape strategies in two of three model families but never produce human-like heterogeneity. We argue for mixed-motive settings that shape agents rather than only test them, and ask whether agents should be pretrained differently from predictors.
c17bea1790859202.abstract_zh:
Sutton 的“苦涩的教训”说，利用算力的通用方法最终胜过手工编码的领域知识。作者指出这个论断有一个常被忽略的前提：Sutton 引用的所有案例里，通用方法都是在与领域工程相同的任务上扩展的。而社会仿真做的是跨任务替换，用为预测文本而优化的产物取代手工构建的智能体。这个做法形似苦涩的教训，但教训本身并不支持它。

核心论点是，预测是一种孤立的行为，预测者不承担其建模的交互带来的后果。合作、背叛和规范执行是有利害关系的各方之间的现象，对一个无利害关系的观察者来说，这些现象在任何规模上都不存在。作者认为 LLM 群体缺的不是涌现（它们已经表现出涌现），而是利害关系（stakes）。

基于这一框架，作者解释了此前工作报告的几类异常：早于对齐训练就出现的过度合作、缺乏个体保真度的集体一致，以及群体同质化。他们还做了一个包含 540 个智能体的试点实验，预先设定假设，检验的是对持续后果的敏感性而非合作本身。结果显示，持续后果在三个模型家族中的两个里重塑了策略，但从未产生人类式的异质性。

作者主张采用混合动机（mixed-motive）的设置，让环境塑造智能体而不只是测试它们，并提出一个开放问题：智能体是否应该用不同于预测器的方式预训练。
c17bea1790859202.why: 这是一篇针对 LLM 社会仿真方法论的批评文章，指出“用文本预测器替代手工智能体”并不被苦涩的教训所许可，并用预注册实验支持“缺的是利害关系而非涌现”的论点，对仿真可信度研究有直接的启发意义。

brief.question: 质疑把 LLM 直接搬进社会仿真这一做法。作者认为 bitter lesson（算力驱动的通用方法胜过手工领域知识）不适用于社会仿真，因为社会仿真把为文本预测优化的模型换到了另一个任务上，而预测是无利害关系的旁观行为，合作、背叛、规范执行这些现象需要有利害关系的参与方。
brief.setup: 材料未说明具体环境与时间尺度。提到一个 540 个智能体的试点实验，使用三个模型家族（具体名称未说明），并预先设定了假设。
brief.method: 试点实验测试的是智能体对持续性后果（persistent consequences）的敏感度，而不是合作行为本身。作者还用同一框架解释了此前工作报告的多个异常现象，包括早于对齐训练就出现的过度合作、缺乏个体保真度的集体一致、以及种群同质化。
brief.findings: 持续性后果在三个模型家族中的两个里改变了智能体策略，但从未产生类似人类的异质性。作者据此主张社会仿真应采用塑造智能体的混合动机（mixed-motive）设定，并追问智能体是否应该用不同于预测器的方式预训练。
brief.validation: 材料未说明具体的验证方式（如与真实人类数据对比或消融实验细节），只说明试点实验采用了预先设定的假设。
brief.limits: 作者自己指出的局限：LLM 种群已表现出涌现，但缺少利害关系（stakes），导致策略改变有限且无法产生人类式异质性。材料未说明其他技术局限。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的观点和方法：用利害关系框架解释过度合作、集体一致、种群同质化等已知异常；设计对持续性后果敏感的混合动机仿真设定；预先设定假设再跑大规模智能体实验的做法。代码和数据未说明。

cdaff7db1b0526dc.text: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in social environments, making it critical to study their ability to faithfully simulate human interactions. Central to this is grounding agents in realistic user personas, yet existing datasets rely on fictional personas and are limited to a handful of languages, lacking the empirical grounding necessary to evaluate behavioral fidelity across diverse populations. We introduce Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset of real-world conversations from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian), paired with personas derived from real user communities and encompassing sociodemographic attributes, self-descriptions, and behaviorally grounded interaction traits. Using Wiki-Talkie, we evaluate agent interactional behavior on a next-turn generation task across various persona conditioning strategies. Our evaluation assesses whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions. Results show that user's comment history exemplifying interaction behavior consistently outperforms explicit persona information. In addition, models systematically underproduce negative or extreme sentiments, while over producing references and suggestions, revealing biases toward agreeableness and positivity. Crucially, these patterns hold robustly across languages, with small cross-lingual differences.
cdaff7db1b0526dc.abstract_zh: LLM 越来越多地作为自主智能体部署在社会环境中，能否忠实模拟人类交互变得关键。现有数据集依赖虚构人格，且只覆盖少数语言，缺少跨人群评估行为保真度的实证基础。作者提出 Wiki-Talkie，一个多语言真实对话数据集，取自五种语言的维基百科讨论页，覆盖两个语系：日耳曼语系（德语、英语）和罗曼语系（西班牙语、法语、意大利语）。每段对话配有从真实用户社区提取的人格，包含社会人口属性、自我描述和基于行为归纳的交互特征。基于该数据集，作者在下一轮生成任务上评测智能体的交互行为，比较不同人格条件化策略，考察智能体整体上能否复现人类讨论中的行为分布模式。结果有两点：一是用用户历史评论作为交互行为的示例，效果稳定优于显式的人格描述信息；二是模型系统性少生成负面或极端情绪，多生成引用和建议，表现出偏向友善和积极的倾向。这些模式在五种语言中稳健成立，跨语言差异很小。局限方面，材料未提及。
cdaff7db1b0526dc.why: 它提供了带真实人格的多语言对话基准，直接回应了仿真智能体行为保真度如何评测的问题；发现的历史评论优于显式人格、以及模型偏积极友善的系统性偏差，对任何用 LLM 模拟人群讨论的研究者都是必须知道的校准陷阱。

brief.question: 评估基于真实用户画像的 LLM 智能体能否忠实模拟真实人类讨论行为，构建多语言的行为保真度基准。
brief.setup: 数据来自 Wikipedia Talk 页面五种语言的真实对话，覆盖两个语系：日耳曼语系（德语、英语）和罗曼语系（西班牙语、法语、意大利语）。画像取自真实用户社区，包含社会人口属性、自我描述和基于行为的互动特征。任务为 next-turn generation，比较多种画像条件化策略。
brief.method: 用 Wiki-Talkie 数据集做下一轮发言生成任务，通过不同画像条件化策略驱动智能体，再检验智能体群体是否复现人类讨论的分布性行为模式。
brief.findings: 用户评论历史（体现互动行为的示例）在效果上稳定优于显式画像信息。模型系统性少生成负面或极端情绪，多生成引用和建议，表现出偏向友善与积极的偏差。这些模式在五种语言中稳健成立，跨语言差异较小。
brief.validation: 将智能体群体的行为分布与人类真实讨论的分布模式对比评估，未说明具体误差指标或强度。
brief.limits: 材料提到现有数据集依赖虚构画像且语言覆盖少，但未说明本方法自身的局限。
brief.reuse: Wiki-Talkie 多语言数据集，含真实对话与带社会人口属性、自我描述、互动特征的用户画像，可直接用于智能体行为评估。

c16b3de4025bbbc6.text: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are expanding the range of behaviors that can be represented in agent-based simulations, but many contemporary platforms are difficult to study, modify, or run on ordinary computers. We present two intentionally minimal simulation foundations for education and rapid prototyping. SD-AgentFoundry-2D provides a two-dimensional multi-agent environment in which locally hosted LLM agents move, communicate, respond to place occupancy, and encounter spatially localized fire events. SD-AgentFoundry-3D provides a three-dimensional digital-twin environment in which a locally hosted VLM receives first-person images and produces natural-language movement instructions. Both codebases are designed to run locally on macOS, Windows, and Linux and are deliberately left open to modification rather than developed as finished applications. Together, they offer accessible starting points for learning about generative social simulation and for building domain-specific extensions.

cc26a72944a48fb4.text: Current video world models struggle in multiplayer environments because they entangle world state with view-dependent visual latents, leading to redundant compute, view inconsistencies, and poor scalability. We propose MASS (Multiplayer world models with Authoritative Shared State) to resolve this limitation. Inspired by multiplayer game architectures, MASS disentangles world dynamics and view rendering. A learned Logic Engine advances a global, authoritative typed state from joint actions without any hand-written transition function, acting as the sole recurrent memory and synchronization reference. From this shared state, a learned Rendering Engine generates independent and consistent views for any requested camera on demand. This explicit disentangling allows MASS to achieve superior state accuracy and lower cross-view inconsistency compared to state-of-the-art multi-view baselines on a matched multiplayer Snake benchmark. It advances predicted worlds with 1,024 concurrent players for 10,000 recurrent steps. Our results show that explicit, authoritative state modeling provides a practical foundation for scalable and consistent multi-agent world simulation.
cc26a72944a48fb4.abstract_zh: 现有视频世界模型在多人环境里表现不好，因为它们把世界状态和依赖视角的视觉潜变量纠缠在一起，导致计算冗余、不同视角之间画面不一致、难以扩展。作者提出 MASS（Multiplayer world models with Authoritative Shared State），思路来自多人游戏架构：把世界动态和视角渲染拆开。一个学习出来的逻辑引擎根据所有玩家的联合动作推进全局的、带类型的权威状态，不依赖任何手写的状态转移函数，这个共享状态是系统里唯一的循环记忆和同步基准。渲染引擎也是学习出来的，从这个共享状态出发，按需为任意请求的相机生成独立且一致的画面。在一个人数对齐的多人贪吃蛇基准上，MASS 的状态准确率高于当前最先进的多视角基线，跨视角不一致性也更低。它还能以 1024 个并发玩家连续推进 1 万个循环步。作者认为，显式的权威状态建模为可扩展、一致的多智能体世界模拟提供了可行基础。
cc26a72944a48fb4.why: 它把多人游戏里“服务器权威状态”的工程经验搬进世界模型，解决了多视角一致性和扩展性问题，对要给大量智能体搭沙盒环境的研究者是可直接借鉴的架构方案。

brief.question: 解决多人环境中视频世界模型的问题：现有模型把世界状态和视角相关的视觉隐变量纠缠在一起，导致冗余计算、跨视角不一致和可扩展性差。
brief.setup: 在匹配的多人 Snake 基准上做仿真，可推进 1,024 个并发玩家、10,000 个循环步的预测世界。使用的具体模型架构细节未说明。
brief.method: 借鉴多人游戏架构，把世界动态和视角渲染解耦。学习到的 Logic Engine 从联合动作推进全局权威类型化状态，不依赖任何手写转移函数，该状态是唯一的循环记忆和同步参照；学习到的 Rendering Engine 从共享状态按需为任意请求的相机生成独立一致的视角。
brief.findings: 在与最先进多视角基线的对比中，MASS 在匹配的多人 Snake 基准上取得更高的状态准确率和更低的跨视角不一致；能推进 1,024 个并发玩家、10,000 个循环步的预测世界。
brief.validation: 与 state-of-the-art 多视角基线在匹配的多人 Snake 基准上对比状态准确率和跨视角一致性，具体误差数字未说明。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: Logic Engine 与 Rendering Engine 的解耦架构思路，以及权威共享状态作为同步参照的设计，可直接借鉴；代码和数据是否开源未说明。

c072e6560a4655bd.text: Persona simulation involves utilizing large language models (LLMs) to anticipate human choices or interactions based on specific characteristic information. To further understand current limitations and future directions, we tested persona simulation in opinion prediction with GPT-4.1 (knowledge cutoff by June 2024). Using personas from nine U.S. states provided by Columbia University's Personas dataset, GPT-4.1 accurately predicted 2024 election outcomes in eight out of the nine states, only failing in one of the swing states. We then focused on opinions related to medicine and healthcare. With the American Trends Panel Wave 123 dataset from Pew Research Center, GPT-4.1 was able to anticipate beliefs about childhood vaccines with an accuracy of up to 0.94. Furthermore, we applied GPT-4.1 to generate conversations among personas and observed that the simulated dialogues and opinions adhered well to personas' personalities and backgrounds, albeit lacking natural human-like flow. Persona simulation proves to be a promising application of artificial intelligence as long as biases are addressed. In the near future, it will be beneficial to apply it to opinion analysis and reaction prediction in diverse fields ranging from public health to lawmaking to economics.

c6fd0694b18109c4.text: Agent-based models (ABMs) rely on simple, explicit and reproducible rules for individual decision making, while complex collective behavior emerges from interactions among agents. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) make it tempting to replace, enrich, or perturb these rules with LLM-based agentic capabilities. However, this raises a methodological question: how does introducing LLM-driven decisions affect the reliability, computational cost, and behavior of ABM simulations? We investigate this for Mesa ABM models, a popular Python library for ABMs, analyzed by statistical model checking. Building on Mesa's integration with the statistical model checker MultiVeStA, we extend the classical Schelling segregation model with a hybrid population: ordinary agents classify neighbors using the standard symbolic rule, while one agent delegates this task to an LLM through tool calls. The LLM-enabled agent receives natural-language descriptions of neighboring agents and invokes tools that increment counters of similar/different neighbors; these counters determine its happiness according to the original Schelling dynamics. This provides a minimal but controlled setting where the semantic, operational, and computational behavior of LLM-based decisions can be studied inside an otherwise standard ABM. We report preliminary experiments with locally served LLMs of different sizes, showing that smaller models may fail simple semantic classification experiments or become operationally unusable during repeated tool-call generation, while larger tested models pass these preliminary checks. We discuss how statistical model checking can estimate classical ABM observables and quantify the impact of introducing agentic LLM components into simulation models.
c6fd0694b18109c4.abstract_zh: 基于智能体的模型（ABM）依赖简单、显式、可复现的个体决策规则，群体层面的复杂行为从智能体交互中涌现。大语言模型的出现让人想把 ABM 里的规则替换、增强或扰动为 LLM 驱动的智能体决策，但这带来一个方法论问题：引入 LLM 决策会如何影响仿真的可靠性、计算成本和行为？作者在 Mesa 这个流行的 Python ABM 库上研究该问题，分析手段是统计模型检测。他们利用 Mesa 与统计模型检测器 MultiVeStA 的已有集成，把经典 Schelling 隔离模型扩展为混合种群：普通智能体用标准符号规则判断邻居是否同类，另有一个智能体把这项判断委托给 LLM。该智能体收到邻居的自然语言描述，调用工具递增同类/异类邻居的计数器，再按原始 Schelling 动力学决定自己的满意度。这构成了一个最小但受控的实验环境，可以在标准 ABM 内部研究 LLM 决策的语义、操作和计算行为。初步实验使用本地部署的不同规模 LLM：较小的模型可能无法通过简单的语义分类测试，或在反复生成工具调用时变得操作上不可用；测试过的较大模型通过了这些初步检验。作者还讨论了如何用统计模型检测估计经典 ABM 观测量，并量化引入智能体 LLM 组件对仿真模型的影响。
c6fd0694b18109c4.why: 它给出了一个最小可控的实验设计，把 LLM 决策嵌入标准 ABM 并用统计模型检测量化其语义、操作和计算影响，对想在仿真推演中引入 LLM 智能体的人是直接可参考的方法论模板，小模型不可用的结论也是实用的选型警示。

brief.question: 在 ABM（agent-based models）中引入 LLM 驱动的智能体决策，会如何影响仿真的可靠性、计算成本和行为？
brief.setup: 基于 Python 库 Mesa 的经典 Schelling 隔离模型，加入混合种群：普通智能体用标准符号规则分类邻居，其中一个智能体通过 tool calls 把分类任务委托给本地部署的 LLM。LLM 智能体接收邻居的自然语言描述，调用工具累加相似/不同邻居的计数器，再按原 Schelling 动力学决定其满意度。使用了不同规模的本地 LLM 做初步实验，具体数量未说明。
brief.method: 利用 Mesa 与统计模型检验器 MultiVeStA 的集成，用统计模型检验（statistical model checking）估计经典 ABM 观测量，并量化引入 LLM 智能体组件的影响。
brief.findings: 较小规模的模型在简单语义分类实验中会失败，或在反复生成 tool calls 时在操作层面不可用；测试过的较大模型通过了这些初步检验。
brief.validation: 通过简单语义分类实验和重复 tool-call 生成的操作性检验来筛选模型，并用统计模型检验量化行为影响；未与真实数据对比。
brief.limits: 作者自称是初步实验（preliminary experiments），且只测试了本地部署的 LLM，规模和范围有限；具体失败率等数字未说明。
brief.reuse: Mesa 与 MultiVeStA 的集成，以及在标准 ABM 中嵌入单个 LLM 智能体做受控实验的混合种群设计，可直接借鉴。

c77ec3d3bfed2f2f.text: The electrification of transportation through electric vehicles introduces new challenges for power grid management, such as increased peak demand, voltage fluctuations, line overloads, and the integration of variable renewable energy sources. To enable efficient integration of EVs while minimizing costs for users and avoiding network overloads, implicit coordination between EVs is required. This work compares two independent multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches for optimizing such decentralized EV charging: contextual combinatorial bandits and policy gradient algorithms. Using a realistic simulation environment with autonomous agents making decisions based on local environmental information (including price signals, state-of-charge, and temporal constraints), we evaluate their performance across varying congestion levels, and mixed-strategy configurations with heterogeneous agent groups under dynamic electricity pricing derived from real photovoltaic production data.

ca5135d2bfaf5102.text: Simulation has long supported supply chain management instruction by letting learners observe network behavior and test decision strategies. Recent progress in LLM-driven agents opens new possibilities for richer, more adaptive simulations, but many existing systems still present abstract, opaque data that overwhelms learners and discourages active exploration. We introduce \textit{SupplyNet}, a gamified visual simulation system built on a contextual graph-based LLM multi-agent framework that models interdependent supply chain dynamics and provides responsive feedback through tiered challenges. \textit{SupplyNet} turns the simulation into a manipulable decision space by integrating an interactive network view of system state, a branching timeline for "what-if" exploration and comparison, and a task-oriented analysis console for structured performance breakdowns. Together, these visual components support counterfactual exploration, causal tracing, and comparative reasoning about outcomes. A user study suggests that \textit{SupplyNet} increases engagement and supports users' perceived understanding of supply chain dynamics, highlighting the potential of pairing contextual multi-agent simulation with visualization to advance operational comprehension.

c97630a3b46c30b7.text: Foundation-model agents in multi-step, open-ended environments frequently suffer from compounding errors, where early mistakes contaminate long-horizon trajectories. While Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) succeeds in deterministic domains, agents in subjective tasks like persuasion experience severe problem drift and sycophantic conformity. We identify semantic leakage in standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) as a reproducible trigger for these failures, as standard RAG prioritizes vocabulary overlap over logical necessity. To eliminate this leakage, we introduce Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG), a systems intervention that routes strategies through a discrete categorical bottleneck to decouple argumentative structure from topical content. Zero-shot, cross-domain evaluations demonstrate that TS-RAG significantly improves the transfer of abstract logic where standard semantic retrieval collapses. Crucially, TS-RAG acts as a "capability bridge" in asymmetric deployments, empowering lightweight persuaders to consistently defeat parametrically superior opponents (improving win rates from 70.5 to 78.5) and accelerating argumentative efficiency. Finally, we introduce trace-level diagnostics via a turn-by-turn Debate State Representation (DSR), demonstrating the necessity of strict constraints to prevent evaluation collapse via default agentic sycophancy.

ccf98a938b2cc8ad.text: Complex cognitive, emotional, and social processes shape human evacuations during natural disasters. Accurate modeling and understanding of human behavior in disasters or emergencies can greatly impact the evacuation process by informing more effective planning and resource allocation. However, collecting human data in these situations is very difficult, and existing computational evacuation models assume rational, homogeneous behavior, leading to unrealistic, overly optimistic predictions. To address this gap, we present a simulation framework of sequential human decision-making during an evacuation scenario, introducing cognitively grounded, persona-driven agents. Our framework models evacuation behavior in a grid-based urban environment that evolves over time, capturing fire and other hazards. Human agents are modeled as personas that make sequential decisions in response to environmental stimuli with cognition structured in three levels: high-level evacuation goals, mid-level route reasoning, and low-level navigation. Decision-making is driven by large language models (LLMs) coupled with a cognitive module and calibrated with empirical human evacuation data. We propose a dynamic, stimulus-driven disaster simulation framework that models human evacuation decision-making using persona-conditioned LLM agents and a cognitive hierarchy.
ccf98a938b2cc8ad.abstract_zh: 灾害中的人类疏散受认知、情绪和社会过程影响，准确建模疏散行为能改进疏散规划和资源分配。但这类场景下的人类数据很难采集，而现有的计算疏散模型假设人是理性且同质的，给出的预测偏乐观、不真实。作者针对这个缺口提出了一个疏散场景下的顺序人类决策仿真框架，引入有认知基础、受人格驱动的智能体。框架在一个随时间演化的网格城市环境中建模疏散行为，环境会捕捉火灾等危险的变化。人类智能体被建模为一个个 persona，根据环境刺激做顺序决策，认知结构分三层：高层是疏散目标，中层是路径推理，底层是导航。决策由大语言模型驱动，配合一个认知模块，并用经验人类疏散数据校准。整体上这是一个动态的、刺激驱动的灾害仿真框架，用人格条件化的 LLM 智能体和认知层级来建模人类疏散决策。材料没有给出具体实验结果数字。
ccf98a938b2cc8ad.why: 它把 LLM 智能体和分层认知结构结合到疏散仿真里，替代传统理性同质假设，并用真实疏散数据校准，对做应急推演和城市仿真的研究者是一个可参考的建模思路。

brief.question: 模拟自然灾害（如火灾）中人类疏散的连续决策行为，解决传统疏散模型假设理性、同质行为导致预测过于乐观的问题。
brief.setup: 在随时间演化的网格化城市环境中模拟疏散，环境包含火灾等危险。人类智能体以 persona 形式建模，由 LLM 驱动决策，配备认知模块。智能体数量和具体 LLM 型号未说明。
brief.method: 提出分层生成式智能体框架，认知分三层：高层疏散目标、中层路线推理、底层导航。决策由 LLM 结合认知模块做出，并用真实人类疏散数据校准。
brief.findings: 材料未给出具体实验数字，仅说明框架能捕捉认知、情感和社会过程对疏散行为的影响。
brief.validation: 用经验性人类疏散数据校准模型，但未说明对比方式、误差大小或消融实验。
brief.limits: 材料提到灾难中收集人类数据本身很困难，这限制了校准数据的获取；其他局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的是 persona 驱动的 LLM 智能体加三层认知层级（目标、路线、导航）的建模方式，以及用真实疏散数据校准 LLM 决策的做法。代码和数据是否公开未说明。

cb6229cd294bf5b8.text: LLMs are increasingly used to simulate human survey responses, but prior work has mainly evaluated replication using mean-level or aggregate agreement, offering limited insight into whether LLMs reproduce the variability of human behavior. We evaluate LLM-based survey replication at the distributional level using a non-public 2010 consumer choice experiment on Korean instant noodle purchases, a setting unlikely to overlap with model training data. We evaluate three response variables of differing statistical type: binary purchase incidence, categorical brand choice, and count purchase quantity. For each, we compare human and LLM responses at mean-level, pattern, and distributional alignment, and against reference baselines from the human data alone. LLMs reproduce condition-level patterns reasonably well but fail to capture distributional structure: for purchase quantity, no model beats a condition-insensitive baseline that simply matches the pooled human distribution. Because models that match human means well can still produce distributions further from humans than this baseline, mean-based evaluation alone can be actively misleading. Replication also varies with input configuration, with structured personas and multimodal inputs improving alignment while explicit reasoning prompting degrades it monotonically.
cb6229cd294bf5b8.abstract_zh: LLM 越来越多地被用来模拟人类的问卷回答，但以往工作主要用均值或聚合层面的一致性来评估复现效果，看不出 LLM 能否复现人类行为的变异性。作者换了一个更严格的检验场景：一份未公开的 2010 年韩国方便面购买消费者选择实验，这个数据集不太可能出现在模型训练数据里，避免了数据泄漏的干扰。实验里有三个统计类型不同的因变量：是否购买的二元变量、品牌选择的类别变量、购买数量的计数变量。对每个变量，作者在均值、模式和分布三个层面比较人类与 LLM 的回答，并只用人类数据本身构造参考基线。结果分两层。条件层面的模式上，LLM 复现得还算合理；但分布结构上不行，购买数量这一项，没有任何模型能超过一个对条件不敏感的基线，这个基线只是简单匹配人类总体分布。作者由此指出，均值匹配得好的模型，其分布可能比这个基线离人类更远，所以只做均值层面的评估可能主动误导结论。复现效果还取决于输入配置：结构化人设和多模态输入能改善对齐，显式推理提示则单调地让对齐变差。局限在于结论来自单一数据集和三个因变量，作者没有讨论在其他场景下是否同样成立。
cb6229cd294bf5b8.why: 它给“用 LLM 当合成受访者”这条路线泼了一盆有数据支撑的冷水：均值对齐不等于分布对齐，而且提供了一个不依赖公开训练数据的检验方案和基线构造方法，做合成样本的人都该照着跑一遍。

resources.name: 2010 年韩国方便面购买消费者选择实验（非公开数据）

brief.question: 检验 LLM 模拟人类问卷回答时能否复现人类行为的分布结构，而不只是均值层面的吻合。
brief.setup: 使用一个未公开的 2010 年韩国方便面购买消费者选择实验数据，该场景不太可能出现在模型训练数据中。考察三个不同统计类型的响应变量：二元的购买发生、类别型的品牌选择、计数型的购买数量。材料未说明具体使用的 LLM 型号和智能体数量。
brief.method: 对每个响应变量，在均值层面、模式层面和分布层面对比人类与 LLM 的回答，并与仅用人类数据构造的参考基线（如直接匹配合并后的人类分布、对条件不敏感的基线）比较。还测试了不同输入配置的影响，包括结构化 persona、多模态输入和显式推理提示。
brief.findings: LLM 能较好复现条件层面的模式，但无法捕捉分布结构。在购买数量上，没有任何模型胜过一个对条件不敏感、直接匹配合并人类分布的基线。均值匹配好的模型，其分布仍可能比该基线更偏离人类，因此仅用均值评估会产生误导。结构化 persona 和多模态输入提升对齐效果，显式推理提示则单调地降低对齐效果。
brief.validation: 与未公开的 2010 年韩国消费者选择实验的真实人类数据对比，覆盖均值、模式和分布三个层级，并引入仅基于人类数据的参考基线。由于数据未公开且不太可能进入训练集，能缓解数据污染问题，但材料未报告具体误差数字。
brief.limits: 材料未说明具体模型、样本量和数值误差。分布层面的失败意味着用 LLM 做需要个体层面变异性的下游分析（如异质性推断）风险较高。
brief.reuse: 分布层面的评估框架可直接借鉴：对二值、类别、计数三类变量分别做均值、模式、分布三层对比，并加入对条件不敏感的基线作为参照。结论提示实践中应使用结构化 persona 和多模态输入，避免显式推理提示。

cbb3b808ee18d805.text: Understanding the dynamic evolution of opinions, such as U.S. public attitudes toward China, is essential for assessing geopolitical risks. However, existing LLM-based multiagent simulators predominantly rely on static rules and fixed datasets, limiting their ability to capture the dynamic, event-driven nature of macro-level opinion shifts in real-world settings. To address this limitation, we propose an Event-Steered Multi-Agent Simulator (ES-MAS), in which significant events and daily news continuously drive opinion evolution through dynamic interactions among agents. We first construct the China-U.S. Relation Evolution (CURE) dataset, covering 20 quarters from 2021 to 2025, including 258 major events and over 14,000 daily news articles, and providing a comprehensive temporal foundation for modeling opinion dynamics. Building upon the CURE dataset, we propose a Dual-Stream Data Integration Engine (DSDIE) that aligns simulations with historical timelines via macro-level events while enabling personalized information exposure based on individual agent profiles and contextual signals. Furthermore, we design a News-Driven Dynamic Interaction (NDDI) module, which adaptively groups agents with shared news interests into localized interaction contexts, facilitating bottom-up consensus formation while mitigating the risk of isolated information cocoons. Experimental results on the CURE dataset demonstrate that ES-MAS substantially outperforms existing simulators in reproducing real-world historical trends, offering a scalable and effective framework for modeling dynamic opinion evolution.
cbb3b808ee18d805.abstract_zh: 研究要解决的问题是：理解美国公众对华态度这类宏观舆论的动态演变对评估地缘政治风险很重要，但现有基于大模型的多智能体仿真器主要依赖静态规则和固定数据集，捕捉不到真实世界里事件驱动的观点变化。为此作者提出事件驱动的多智能体仿真器 ES-MAS，让重大事件和每日新闻通过智能体间的动态交互持续推动观点演化。数据方面，作者构建了中美关系演化数据集 CURE，覆盖 2021 到 2025 年的 20 个季度，包含 258 个重大事件和超过 14000 篇每日新闻，为建模观点动态提供了时间维度上的基础。方法上有两个设计。双流数据整合引擎（DSDIE）在宏观层面用事件把仿真对齐到历史时间线，同时根据每个智能体的人物画像和上下文信号实现个性化的信息暴露。新闻驱动动态交互模块（NDDI）把对相同新闻感兴趣的智能体自适应地聚成局部交互场景，支持自下而上的共识形成，同时降低陷入信息茧房的风险。在 CURE 数据集上的实验表明，ES-MAS 在复现真实历史趋势方面明显优于现有仿真器，提供了一个可扩展的动态观点演化建模框架。
cbb3b808ee18d805.why: 它把静态数据集式的 LLM 舆论仿真推进到事件和时间线驱动，CURE 数据集（258 个事件加 1.4 万篇新闻）本身也是可复用的中美关系建模资源。

brief.question: 推演美国公众对华态度如何随重大事件和日常新闻动态演变，用于评估地缘政治风险。现有 LLM 多智能体仿真依赖静态规则和固定数据集，难以捕捉事件驱动的宏观意见变化。
brief.setup: 构建了覆盖 2021 至 2025 年共 20 个季度的 China-U.S. Relation Evolution（CURE）数据集，含 258 个重大事件和超过 14,000 篇每日新闻；智能体基于个人画像和情境信号接收个性化信息。使用的底层 LLM 模型未说明。
brief.method: 提出 Event-Steered Multi-Agent Simulator（ES-MAS）。Dual-Stream Data Integration Engine（DSDIE）用宏观事件对齐历史时间线，同时按智能体画像做个性化信息暴露；News-Driven Dynamic Interaction（NDDI）模块把对相同新闻感兴趣的智能体自适应分组到局部交互环境，促进自下而上的共识形成，并降低信息茧房风险。
brief.findings: 在 CURE 数据集上的实验显示，ES-MAS 在复现真实历史趋势方面显著优于现有仿真器。材料未给出具体误差数字。
brief.validation: 与 CURE 数据集中的真实历史趋势对比，ES-MAS 优于现有基线仿真器，但材料未说明具体误差指标或对比强度。
brief.limits: 材料未说明。
brief.reuse: CURE 数据集（20 个季度、258 个事件、14,000 余篇新闻）以及 DSDIE、NDDI 两个模块的设计思路可供复用；代码是否开源未说明。

c9b413341b8399d5.text: GUI agents powered by large language models are advancing rapidly, creating urgent needs for evaluation and training based on realistic environments. However, directly doing so in real-world environments introduces some challenges that cannot be overlooked. Real-world environments are complex and uncontrollable, making it difficult to construct verifiable rewards and to save or reset states. Existing works prioritize reproducibility but are often limited to open-source apps or file-operation tasks for reliable reward building, leaving a persistent gap from real-world usage. Furthermore, relying on virtual machines or docker images demand high resource requirements and suffer from slow response speeds, which limit the efficiency. We present \sys, a framework that could produce high-fidelity synthesized interactive environments for GUI agents across platforms with verifiable rewards. These environments behave as backend-free webpages accessible via URL, requiring near-zero setup and low resource cost, making the approach suitable for both large-scale evaluation and downstream agent training. We support multiple GUI platforms including mobile, desktop, and automotive/in-vehicle interfaces based on the same pipeline, covering 100+ environments and 1000+ verifiable tasks. Among them, 120 challenging tasks across 63 simulated mobile applications are released as a fully synthesized mobile GUI agent benchmark. Experiment results on five state-of-the-art mobile GUI agents reveal substantial headroom -- the average success rate is only 27.92\%, dropping to 17.82\% on long-horizon subset -- while humans reach 92.08\%. A comparison against real-world sample tasks shows that assessments made in our synthetic environments generalize to real apps. The project website is at https://scalewob.github.io.

c13e6d1e7b4c09d8.text: We study behavioral alignment and representation dynamics of large language model (LLM) agents in financial decision environments. TradeArena, an auditable trading-agent testbed with risk reports, execution simulation, memory, and replayable trajectories, lets us analyze how rationales, positions, and interventions evolve under market stress. Code and data artifacts are available through the \href{https://github.com/weich97/TreLLM-public}{TradeArena repository}. We find pre-failure signatures: planning embeddings drift from normal centroids, fused plan-risk representations separate normal from pre-drawdown states, and local manifolds exhibit effective-rank contraction. Across 80 rolling failure anchors and eight LLM trajectories, this pattern persists across hash, LSA, Transformer, and white-box hidden-state probes. Stress tests with CoT-free target weights, lexical controls, OHLCV noise, and false audits show that rationale-level contraction can vanish without rationales, while intent-space and fused signatures remain informative. Structured risk feedback can act as an external alignment signal without fine-tuning, but not as a universal performance enhancer: true audit feedback improves calibration for some models, returns for others, and exposes cases where placebo or hidden feedback has higher short-horizon return but weaker alignment diagnostics. A 51-stock intraday experiment reveals a correlation blind spot: LLM rationales justify exposure to coupled assets that the risk layer clips. Finally, a financial-audit task suite shifts comparison from ``which model trades best'' to whether models can audit trajectories, respect execution boundaries, reproduce artifacts, and avoid claim overreach. These results support a research claim, not a profitability claim: auditable risk feedback and representation trajectories reveal when LLM financial reasoning is aligning, drifting, or failing.

c6693bb7de7b2dd9.text: When two LLM agents with structurally opposed objectives interact across multiple turns, the absence of a shared goal function produces not competition but collapse: the visitor capitulates, the site agent stops varying its approach, and the conversation terminates without achieving either agent's stated objective. This paper asks whether a control-theoretic governance layer can substitute for that missing goal function. The Experience Orchestrator (EO) addresses this in a simulated financial services environment where a site agent guides a visitor toward advisor contact while the visitor maintains psychologically realistic resistance. EO governs the joint trajectory through three mechanisms: a Contextual Bandit (CB) that selects content arms calibrated from real-world web analytics, a PID controller that enforces behavioral consistency via dynamic schema constraints, and a POMDP belief tracker that maintains a probabilistic model of visitor intent. Across 60,000 simulations, EO achieves a +32 percentage point lift in high-intent advisor contact rate (78.1% vs. 46.1% over a naive LLM control), with CB variant selection accounting for 97% of between-factor outcome variance -- confirming that the governance policy, not environmental initial conditions, determines where trajectories end up. Persona-level analysis reveals two distinct regimes: for visitors with no natural inclination toward conversion, the governance layer is the difference between a functional system and a non-functional one; for visitors already near alignment, a naive LLM's empathetic defaults are largely sufficient. All findings are conditional on LLM-to-LLM simulation. The PID controller has not been calibrated against real human unpredictability, and validating EO on live traffic is the critical next step.

c42f31a2d9300300.text: BotVerse is a scalable, event-driven framework for high-fidelity social simulation using LLM-based agents. It addresses the ethical risks of studying autonomous agents on live networks by isolating interactions within a controlled environment while grounding them in real-time content streams from the Bluesky ecosystem. The system features an asynchronous orchestration API and a simulation engine that emulates human-like temporal patterns and cognitive memory. Through the Synthetic Social Observatory, researchers can deploy customizable personas and observe multimodal interactions at scale. We demonstrate BotVersevia a coordinated disinformation scenario, providing a safe, experimental framework for red-teaming and computational social scientists. A video demonstration of the framework is available at https://youtu.be/eZSzO5Jarqk.

cb7e66c2aaff6939.text: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly tested on complex tasks, but their ability to allocate scarce resources over long horizons remains unclear. Unlike reactive tasks with immediate feedback, this setting requires agents to make binding commitments under partial observability, delayed consequences, hard resource budgets, and shifting dynamics. We introduce EnterpriseArena, a 132-month CFO simulator that evaluates long-horizon resource allocation under uncertainty in a FinTech lending firm. Agents must manage liquidity, close books, gather costly signals, and request equity or debt financing across changing macroeconomic regimes. The simulator is built from transformed firm-level financial data, anonymized business documents, decade-scale macroeconomic and industry signals, and expert-validated operating rules. Experiments across 23 LLMs and four agent frameworks show that current agents remain far from robust: only 15.4% of trials survive the full horizon, larger models do not reliably outperform smaller ones, and failures cascade across observation, action timing, and capital sizing. These findings establish long-horizon resource allocation under uncertainty as a distinct capability gap for LLM agents.
cb7e66c2aaff6939.abstract_zh:
LLM 智能体在复杂任务上被越来越多地测试，但它们能否在长周期里分配稀缺资源仍不清楚。与有即时反馈的反应式任务不同，这个场景要求智能体在部分可观测、后果延迟、资源预算硬约束和动态变化的环境里做出有约束力的承诺。

作者提出 EnterpriseArena，一个 132 个月的 CFO 模拟器，在一家金融科技借贷公司里评估不确定性下的长期资源配置。智能体要管理流动性、结账、付费获取信号，并在变化的宏观经济周期中申请股权或债务融资。模拟器由转换后的企业级财务数据、匿名化商业文档、十年尺度的宏观与行业信号以及专家验证的运营规则构建。

实验覆盖 23 个 LLM 和四种智能体框架。结果很弱：只有 15.4% 的试验存活到整个周期结束，更大的模型并不能稳定地跑赢小模型，失败会在观察、行动时机和资本规模三个环节上连锁发生。作者据此把不确定性下的长期资源配置确立为 LLM 智能体的一项独立能力缺口。
cb7e66c2aaff6939.why: 它提供了一个用真实企业财务数据和十年宏观信号构建的长周期 CFO 仿真基准，测试结果本身就是一个反例：当前 LLM 智能体在硬预算约束和延迟后果下远不可靠，做经济仿真和智能体评测的人都该知道这个边界。

brief.question: LLM 智能体能否胜任 CFO 的长周期资源分配任务，即在部分可观测、后果延迟、预算硬约束和动态变化的环境下做出有约束力的承诺。
brief.setup: EnterpriseArena 是一个 132 个月的 CFO 模拟器，场景是一家 FinTech 借贷公司。智能体需管理流动性、结账、获取有成本的信息信号，并在变化的宏观经济周期中申请股权或债务融资。测试覆盖 23 个 LLM 和四种智能体框架。
brief.method: 模拟器由转换后的企业级财务数据、匿名化商业文档、十年尺度的宏观与行业信号以及经专家验证的运营规则构建。智能体需在多变的宏观周期下做长期资源配置决策。
brief.findings: 当前智能体远不稳健：仅 15.4% 的试验存活到完整周期；更大的模型并不稳定地优于小模型；失败会在观察、行动时机和资本规模确定之间级联扩散。
brief.validation: 未说明（材料提到模拟器基于专家验证的运营规则，但未给出与真实数据对比的具体验证方式和强度）。
brief.limits: 材料指出长周期不确定性下的资源分配是 LLM 智能体的一个独立能力缺口，失败会跨观察、时机、资本规模级联；其他局限未说明。
brief.reuse: EnterpriseArena 模拟器本身可作为基准使用；代码或数据是否公开未说明。

c3808aacf816453d.text: As NLP evaluation shifts from static benchmarks to multi-turn interactive settings, LLM-based simulators have become widely used as user proxies, serving two roles: generating user turns and providing evaluation signals. Yet, these simulations are frequently assumed to be faithful to real human behaviors, often without rigorous verification. We formalize the Sim2Real gap in user simulation and present the first study running the full $τ$-bench protocol with real humans (451 participants, 165 tasks), benchmarking 31 LLM simulators across proprietary, open-source, and specialized families using the User-Sim Index (USI), a metric we introduce to quantify how well LLM simulators resemble real user interactive behaviors and feedback. Behaviorally, LLM simulators are excessively cooperative, stylistically uniform, and lack realistic frustration or ambiguity, creating an "easy mode" that inflates agent success rates above the human baseline. In evaluations, real humans provide nuanced judgments across eight quality dimensions while simulated users produce uniformly more positive feedback; rule-based rewards are failing to capture rich feedback signals generated by human users. Overall, higher general model capability does not necessarily yield more faithful user simulation. These findings highlight the importance of human validation when using LLM-based user simulators in the agent development cycle and motivate improved models for user simulation.
c3808aacf816453d.abstract_zh: NLP评测正从静态基准转向多轮交互场景，基于LLM的用户模拟器被广泛用作真人代理，承担两个角色：生成用户回合和提供评测信号。但这些模拟常被默认忠实于真实人类行为，缺少严格验证。作者把用户模拟中的Sim2Real差距形式化，做了第一项让真人（451名参与者、165个任务）跑完整τ-bench协议的研究，用他们提出的User-Sim Index（USI）指标，在专有、开源和专用模型共31个LLM模拟器上评测其与真实用户交互行为和反馈的相似程度。行为上，LLM模拟器过于合作，风格统一，缺少真实的挫败感或模糊表达，形成一种“简单模式”，使智能体的成功率虚高到超过真人基线。在评测信号上，真人用户会在八个质量维度上给出细致的判断，而模拟用户给出的反馈一律更正面；基于规则的奖励也无法捕捉真人用户产生的丰富反馈信号。此外，通用能力更强的模型并不一定带来更忠实的用户模拟。这些发现说明，在智能体开发流程中使用LLM用户模拟器时必须做人类验证，也推动了更好的用户模拟模型的研发。
c3808aacf816453d.why: 它给“LLM用户模拟器能否替代真人”这个问题提供了第一份大规模真人对照证据，提出的USI指标和真人τ-bench数据可直接用于校准和评测智能体仿真流程。

brief.question: LLM 用户模拟器在多轮交互评测中是否忠实于真实人类行为，Sim2Real 差距有多大。
brief.setup: 在 τ$-bench 完整协议上对比 31 个 LLM 模拟器（专有、开源、专用模型），与 451 名真人参与者完成 165 个任务的行为和反馈对照。
brief.method: 提出 User-Sim Index (USI) 指标，量化 LLM 模拟器与真实用户交互行为和反馈的相似度，并系统跑完整 τ$-bench 协议。
brief.findings: LLM 模拟器过度合作、风格单一、缺少真实的挫败感和模糊表达，形成“简单模式”，使 agent 成功率虚高于人类基线。真人反馈覆盖八个质量维度且更细致，模拟用户反馈一律更正面；基于规则的奖励无法捕捉人类反馈信号。模型通用能力越强不代表用户模拟越忠实。
brief.validation: 与 451 名真人完成同一 τ$-bench 协议的结果直接对比，属于真实人类基准验证，强度较高。
brief.limits: 材料提到过度合作、风格统一等行为偏差，但未说明具体误差数值；未说明是否覆盖其他任务域。
brief.reuse: USI 指标和完整 τ$-bench 人类基线协议可用于评估用户模拟器忠实度，材料未说明是否开源代码或数据。

c77f3861f45a1958.text: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in language-centric tasks. However, in agentic settings, LLMs often struggle to anticipate action consequences and adapt to environment dynamics, highlighting the need for world-modeling capabilities in LLM-based agents. We propose Reinforcement World Model Learning (RWML), a self-supervised method that learns action-conditioned world models for LLM-based agents on textual states using sim-to-real gap rewards. Our method aligns simulated next states produced by the model with realized next states observed from the environment, encouraging consistency between internal world simulations and actual environment dynamics in a pre-trained embedding space. Unlike next-state token prediction, which prioritizes token-level fidelity (i.e., reproducing exact wording) over semantic equivalence and can lead to model collapse, our method provides a more robust training signal and is empirically less susceptible to reward hacking than LLM-as-a-judge. We evaluate our method on ALFWorld and $τ^2$ Bench and observe significant gains over the base model, despite using no expert data, task-success rewards, or strong-LLM annotations - only an off-the-shelf embedding model as a distance metric. When combined with task-success rewards, our method outperforms direct task-success reward RL by 6.9 and 5.7 points on ALFWorld and $τ^2$ Bench respectively; it further outperforms expert-data training on ALFWorld and is comparable to it on $τ^2$ Bench.
c77f3861f45a1958.abstract_zh: LLM 在语言任务上表现很强，但在智能体场景里往往难以预判动作后果、难以适应环境动态，作者认为这暴露了 LLM 智能体缺少世界建模能力。他们提出 RWML，一种自监督方法，在文本状态上为 LLM 智能体学习动作条件化的世界模型，训练信号来自仿真到现实的差距奖励：模型生成的模拟下一状态要与环境中实际观测到的下一状态对齐，对齐在一个预训练嵌入空间中度量，从而让内部仿真与环境真实动态保持一致。作者指出，直接做下一状态的 token 预测会优先追求逐字复现而牺牲语义等价，可能导致模型坍缩；RWML 的训练信号更稳健，实验上也比 LLM-as-a-judge 更不容易被奖励黑客利用。评测在 ALFWorld 和 τ² Bench 上进行。只用一个现成嵌入模型做距离度量，不用专家数据、任务成功奖励或强 LLM 标注，RWML 就显著超过基座模型。与任务成功奖励结合后，在 ALFWorld 和 τ² Bench 上分别比直接用任务奖励做强化学习高 6.9 和 5.7 个点；在 ALFWorld 上还超过了用专家数据训练的模型，在 τ² Bench 上与之相当。局限方面材料未展开讨论。
c77f3861f45a1958.why: 它给沙盘推演和仿真环境里的 LLM 智能体提供了一条自监督学习世界模型的路线，不需要专家轨迹或强模型标注，且对奖励黑客更稳健，方法可直接迁移到其他文本环境。

brief.question: LLM 智能体在环境中难以预判动作后果、适应环境动态，缺少世界建模能力，RWML 要解决这个问题。
brief.setup: 面向基于 LLM 的文本环境智能体，评测环境为 ALFWorld 和 τ² Bench，其余智能体数量、时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: RWML 是自监督方法，学习动作条件化的世界模型：用 sim-to-real gap 奖励，让模型生成的模拟下一状态与环境中实际观测到的下一状态在预训练嵌入空间中对齐。不用下一状态 token 预测（其追求逐词复现而非语义等价，可能导致模型坍缩），也比 LLM-as-a-judge 更不易被 reward hacking。
brief.findings: 不使用专家数据、任务成功奖励或强 LLM 标注，只用现成嵌入模型做距离度量，即显著超过基座模型。与任务成功奖励结合时，比直接用任务成功奖励做 RL 在 ALFWorld 和 τ² Bench 上分别高 6.9 和 5.7 分；在 ALFWorld 上超过专家数据训练，在 τ² Bench 上与之相当。
brief.validation: 与基座模型、任务成功奖励 RL、专家数据训练三种基线在 ALFWorld 和 τ² Bench 上对比，报告了具体分差；未说明与真实世界数据或人类表现的对比。
brief.limits: 材料提到下一状态 token 预测可能导致模型坍缩、LLM-as-a-judge 易被 reward hacking，这是对替代方法的局限；RWML 自身的局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 方法本身：sim-to-real gap 奖励加现成嵌入模型做距离度量，无需专家数据即可训练世界模型；代码和数据未说明。

ca4e9294e2f29dda.text: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has sparked growing interest in their integration into autonomous systems for reasoning-driven perception, planning, and decision-making. However, evaluating and training such agentic AI models remains challenging due to the lack of large-scale, structured, and safety-critical benchmarks. This paper introduces AgentDrive, an open benchmark dataset containing 300,000 LLM-generated driving scenarios designed for training, fine-tuning, and evaluating autonomous agents under diverse conditions. AgentDrive formalizes a factorized scenario space across seven orthogonal axes: scenario type, driver behavior, environment, road layout, objective, difficulty, and traffic density. An LLM-driven prompt-to-JSON pipeline generates semantically rich, simulation-ready specifications that are validated against physical and schema constraints. Each scenario undergoes simulation rollouts, surrogate safety metric computation, and rule-based outcome labeling. To complement simulation-based evaluation, we introduce AgentDrive-MCQ, a 100,000-question multiple-choice benchmark spanning five reasoning dimensions: physics, policy, hybrid, scenario, and comparative reasoning. We conduct a large-scale evaluation of fifty leading LLMs on AgentDrive-MCQ. Results show that while proprietary frontier models perform best in contextual and policy reasoning, advanced open models are rapidly closing the gap in structured and physics-grounded reasoning. We release the AgentDrive dataset, AgentDrive-MCQ benchmark, evaluation code, and related materials at https://github.com/maferrag/AgentDrive

cea495165a6b9629.text: Motivated by the remarkable progress of large language models (LLMs) in objective tasks like mathematics and coding, there is growing interest in their potential to simulate human behavior--a capability with profound implications for transforming social science research and customer-centric business insights. However, LLMs often lack a nuanced understanding of human cognition and behavior, limiting their effectiveness in social simulation and personalized applications. We posit that this limitation stems from a fundamental misalignment: standard LLM pretraining on vast, uncontextualized web data does not capture the continuous, situated context of an individual's decisions, thoughts, and behaviors over time. To bridge this gap, we introduce HumanLLM, a foundation model designed for personalized understanding and simulation of individuals. We first construct the Cognitive Genome Dataset, a large-scale corpus curated from real-world user data on platforms like Reddit, Twitter, Blogger, and Amazon. Through a rigorous, multi-stage pipeline involving data filtering, synthesis, and quality control, we automatically extract over 5.5 million user logs to distill rich profiles, behaviors, and thinking patterns. We then formulate diverse learning tasks and perform supervised fine-tuning to empower the model to predict a wide range of individualized human behaviors, thoughts, and experiences. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that HumanLLM achieves superior performance in predicting user actions and inner thoughts, more accurately mimics user writing styles and preferences, and generates more authentic user profiles compared to base models. Furthermore, HumanLLM shows significant gains on out-of-domain social intelligence benchmarks, indicating enhanced generalization.
cea495165a6b9629.abstract_zh:
LLM 在数学、代码这类客观任务上进步很快，但模拟人类行为时常常缺乏对人类认知和行为的细致理解，这限制了它在社会仿真和个性化应用中的效果。作者把问题归结为一个根本性的错位：标准 LLM 的预训练用的是海量、去情境化的网络数据，捕捉不到一个人在时间线上连续的、处于具体情境中的决策、想法和行为。

为弥合这个缺口，作者构建了 Cognitive Genome Dataset。数据来自 Reddit、Twitter、Blogger 和 Amazon 上的真实用户，经过数据过滤、合成和质量控制的多阶段流水线，自动提取出超过 550 万条用户日志，从中提炼出用户画像、行为和思维模式。在此之上，作者设计了多种学习任务做监督微调，让模型学会预测各类个体化的人类行为、想法和经历，得到基座模型 HumanLLM。

评测显示，HumanLLM 在预测用户行为和内心想法上表现更好，能更准确地模仿用户的写作风格和偏好，生成的用户画像也比基座模型更真实。此外，它在域外的社交智能基准上也有明显提升，说明泛化能力得到了增强。材料未说明评测具体对照了哪些真实数据或实验设置。
cea495165a6b9629.why: 它给出了把真实用户日志蒸馏成微调语料、再训练个性化行为模拟模型的完整流水线，对做人类行为仿真和合成样本的人是可直接参考的方法路线，550 万条日志的数据构建流程也可复用。

brief.question: 解决通用 LLM 在模拟个体人类行为时缺乏对个人认知和行为的细致理解的问题，目标是实现个性化的行为仿真与理解。
brief.setup: 构建了 Cognitive Genome Dataset，从 Reddit、Twitter、Blogger、Amazon 等平台的真实用户数据中，经数据过滤、合成和质量控制的多阶段流程，自动提取超过 550 万条用户日志，提炼出用户画像、行为和思维模式。基础模型的具体架构和参数量未说明。
brief.method: 在提取的用户日志基础上设计多种学习任务，做监督微调（supervised fine-tuning），让模型预测个体的行为、想法和经历。
brief.findings: HumanLLM 在预测用户行为和内心想法上优于基座模型，能更准确模仿用户写作风格和偏好，生成更真实的用户画像；在域外社交智能基准上也有显著提升。具体数字未说明。
brief.validation: 与基座模型对比评估，并在域外社交智能基准上测试泛化能力；未说明与真实人类数据或真实行为的定量误差对比。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: Cognitive Genome Dataset 的构建流程（多阶段数据过滤、合成、质量控制）和从真实平台日志提炼用户画像的方法可借鉴；代码和数据是否开源未说明。

c3a0711508dc8778.text: Supply chains (SCs), complex networks spanning from raw material acquisition to product delivery, with enterprises as interconnected nodes, play a pivotal role in organizational success. However, optimizing SCs remains challenging, particularly in partner selection, a key bottleneck shaped by competitive and cooperative dynamics. This challenge constitutes a multi-objective dynamic game requiring a synergistic integration of Multi-Criteria Decision-Making and Game Theory. Traditional approaches, grounded in mathematical simplifications and managerial heuristics, fail to capture real-world intricacies and risk introducing subjective biases. Multi-agent simulation offers promise, but prior research has largely relied on fixed, uniform agent logic, limiting practical applicability. Recent advances in LLMs create opportunities to represent complex SC requirements and hybrid game logic. However, challenges persist in modeling dynamic SC relationships, ensuring interpretability, and balancing agent autonomy with expert control. We present SCSimulator, a visual analytics framework that integrates LLM-driven MAS with human-in-the-loop collaboration for SC partner selection. It simulates SC evolution via adaptive network structures and enterprise behaviors, which are visualized via interpretable interfaces. By combining CoT reasoning with XAI techniques, it generates multi-faceted, transparent explanations of decision trade-offs. Users can iteratively adjust simulation settings to explore outcomes aligned with their expectations and strategic priorities. Developed through iterative co-design with SC experts and industry managers, SCSimulator serves as a proof-of-concept, offering methodological contributions and practical insights for future research on SC decision-making and interactive AI-driven analytics. Usage scenarios and a user study demonstrate the system's effectiveness and usability.
c3a0711508dc8778.abstract_zh: 供应链是从原材料获取到产品交付的复杂网络，企业作为相互连接的节点，其优化对组织成功至关重要，而伙伴选择是其中的关键瓶颈，受竞争与合作动态共同影响。这个问题本质上是一个多目标动态博弈，需要把多准则决策与博弈论结合起来。传统方法依赖数学简化和管理经验启发式，难以捕捉现实复杂性，还可能引入主观偏差。多智能体仿真提供了新途径，但以往研究大多采用固定、统一的智能体逻辑，实用性受限。大语言模型的进展让刻画复杂供应链需求和混合博弈逻辑成为可能，但如何建模动态供应链关系、保证可解释性、平衡智能体自主性与专家控制仍是难题。作者提出 SCSimulator，一个把大模型驱动的多智能体仿真与人在回路协作结合的可视化分析框架，用于供应链伙伴选择。系统通过自适应网络结构和企业行为模拟供应链演化，并用可解释的界面进行可视化。它把思维链推理与可解释 AI 技术结合，生成多方面、透明的决策权衡解释。用户可以迭代调整仿真设置，探索符合自身期望和战略优先级的结果。该框架通过与供应链专家和行业管理者迭代共同设计开发而成，作为概念验证，为供应链决策研究和交互式 AI 分析提供方法贡献与实践参考。使用场景和用户研究展示了系统的有效性与可用性。
c3a0711508dc8778.why: 它示范了如何把大模型多智能体仿真做成可解释、人在回路的决策分析工具，对做组织与供应链博弈推演的研究者是一个可参考的框架设计案例。

c414ddb8acf55525.text: With the rapid development of the online education and large language model, the existing educational tools still suffer from incomplete service, insufficient performance and weak interactivity in terms of courseware generation, interactive notes and quality assurance of content. In particular, the proposed generative agent EZYer : 1) Teacher Module: Integrating the Text Corpus retrieval and in-depth generation technologies, it automatically generates structured teaching materials and LaTeX Beamer courseware in line with the high school mathematics syllabus and supports user-defined image insertion. 2) Student Module: Throughout the collaborative interaction of the four roles of Teacher, Assistant, Top Student and Struggling Student, Note Taker summarizes and generates academic notes to enhance the depth and interest of learning. 3) Controller: set up keyword filtering system, content scoring system, role co-validation system, and dynamic content correction system. This ensure academic strictness and pedagogical propriety of EZYer inputs and outputs. In order to evaluate EZYer, this paper designs five-dimensional evaluation indexes of content accuracy, knowledge coverage, usability, formatting correctness and visual design and appeal, and scores 100 Beamer and Notes generated by EZYer by five large language models, separately, and the results show that the quality of EZYer-generated content is excellent and has a good application prospect.

c3ac1c168ce68ab1.text: Autonomous driving faces critical challenges in rare long-tail events and complex multi-agent interactions, which are scarce in real-world data yet essential for robust safety validation. This paper presents a high-fidelity scenario generation framework that integrates a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) with a large language model (LLM). The CVAE encodes historical trajectories and map information from large-scale naturalistic datasets to learn latent traffic structures, enabling the generation of physically consistent base scenarios. Building on this, the LLM acts as an adversarial reasoning engine, parsing unstructured scene descriptions into domain-specific loss functions and dynamically guiding scenario generation across varying risk levels. This knowledge-driven optimization balances realism with controllability, ensuring that generated scenarios remain both plausible and risk-sensitive. Extensive experiments in CARLA and SMARTS demonstrate that our framework substantially increases the coverage of high-risk and long-tail events, improves consistency between simulated and real-world traffic distributions, and exposes autonomous driving systems to interactions that are significantly more challenging than those produced by existing rule- or data-driven methods. These results establish a new pathway for safety validation, enabling principled stress-testing of autonomous systems under rare but consequential events.

c9143a1f2ac2cace.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings, yet little is known about how they coordinate when treated as black-box agents. We simulate 7500 multi-agent, multi-round discussions in an inductive coding task, generating over 125000 utterances that capture both final annotations and their interactional histories. We introduce process-level metrics: code stability, semantic self-consistency, and lexical confidence alongside sentiment and convergence measures, to track coordination dynamics. To probe deeper alignment signals, we analyze the evolving geometry of output embeddings, showing that intrinsic dimensionality declines over rounds, suggesting semantic compression. The results reveal that LLM groups converge lexically and semantically, develop asymmetric influence patterns, and exhibit negotiation-like behaviors despite the absence of explicit role prompting. This work demonstrates how black-box interaction analysis can surface emergent coordination strategies, offering a scalable complement to internal probe-based interpretability methods.

cea02f2b5c275d28.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) show remarkable potential for urban computing, from spatial reasoning to predictive analytics. However, evaluating LLMs across diverse urban tasks faces two critical challenges: lack of unified platforms for consistent multi-source data access and fragmented task definitions that hinder fair comparison. To address these challenges, we present CityVerse, the first unified platform integrating multi-source urban data, capability-based task taxonomy, and dynamic simulation for systematic LLM evaluation in urban contexts. CityVerse provides: 1) coordinate-based Data APIs unifying ten categories of urban data-including spatial features, temporal dynamics, demographics, and multi-modal imagery-with over 38 million curated records; 2) Task APIs organizing 43 urban computing tasks into a four-level cognitive hierarchy: Perception, Spatial Understanding, Reasoning and Prediction, and Decision and Interaction, enabling standardized evaluation across capability levels; 3) an interactive visualization frontend supporting real-time data retrieval, multi-layer display, and simulation replay for intuitive exploration and validation. We validate the platform's effectiveness through evaluations on mainstream LLMs across representative tasks, demonstrating its capability to support reproducible and systematic assessment. CityVerse provides a reusable foundation for advancing LLMs and multi-task approaches in the urban computing domain.

c15926900741d563.text: Regulators currently govern the AI data economy based on intuition rather than evidence, struggling to choose between inconsistent regimes of informed consent, immunity, and liability. To fill this policy vacuum, this paper develops a novel computational policy laboratory: a spatially explicit Agent-Based Model (ABM) of the data market. To solve the problem of missing data, we introduce a two-stage methodological pipeline. First, we translate decision rules from multi-year fieldwork (2022-2025) into agent constraints. This ensures the model reflects actual bargaining frictions rather than theoretical abstractions. Second, we deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) as "subjects" in a Discrete Choice Experiment (DCE). This novel approach recovers precise preference primitives, such as willingness-to-pay elasticities, which are empirically unobservable in the wild. Calibrated by these inputs, our model places rival legal institutions side-by-side to simulate their welfare effects. The results challenge the dominant regulatory paradigm. We find that property-rule mechanisms, such as informed consent, fail to maximize welfare. Counterintuitively, social welfare peaks when liability for substantive harm is shifted to the downstream buyer. This aligns with the "least cost avoider" principle, because downstream users control post-acquisition safeguards, they are best positioned to mitigate risk efficiently. By "de-romanticizing" seller-centric frameworks, this paper provides an economic justification for emerging doctrines of downstream reachability.
c15926900741d563.abstract_zh:
监管者目前主要凭直觉而非证据治理AI数据经济，在知情同意、豁免和责任这几套不一致的制度之间难以取舍。为了填补这个政策空白，作者开发了一个计算政策实验室：一个空间显式的数据市场智能体模型（ABM）。

针对数据缺失问题，论文提出两阶段方法。第一阶段把2022至2025年多年田野调查得到的决策规则转译为智能体约束，让模型反映真实的议价摩擦而非理论抽象。第二阶段用大语言模型充当离散选择实验（DCE）中的受试者，恢复支付意愿弹性等在现实中无法直接观测的偏好参数。

用这些输入校准后，模型把相互竞争的法律制度并排放在一起模拟各自的福利效应。结果挑战了主流监管范式：知情同意这类产权规则机制没有最大化福利。反直觉的是，当实质损害的责任被转移给下游购买方时，社会福利达到峰值。这与“最低成本规避者”原则一致，因为下游用户控制获取后的防护措施，最有条件高效地降低风险。

论文通过去浪漫化以卖方为中心的框架，为新兴的下游可追责学说提供了经济学依据。
c15926900741d563.why: 它示范了一条可复用的校准路线：田野调查定行为规则、大模型当DCE受试者补偏好参数，再拿ABM比较法律制度的福利效果，对做政策推演的人是方法上的直接参考；结论本身（责任后移优于知情同意）也和主流监管直觉相反，值得对照检验。

brief.question: AI 数据经济的监管目前靠直觉而非证据，监管者在知情同意、豁免、责任等不一致的法律制度之间难以取舍，论文要推演不同数据法律制度的福利效果。
brief.setup: 构建了一个空间显式的数据市场 Agent-Based Model（ABM），智能体约束来自 2022-2025 多年田野调查的决策规则，另用 LLM 作为 Discrete Choice Experiment（DCE）中的被试来恢复偏好参数。
brief.method: 两阶段方法管线：先把田野调查得到的决策规则转译为智能体约束，保证模型反映真实议价摩擦；再用 LLM 做 DCE，恢复支付意愿弹性等在现实中无法观测的偏好原语，以此校准模型，把不同法律制度并排放置模拟其福利效果。
brief.findings: 财产规则类机制（如知情同意）无法最大化福利；反直觉的是，当实质性损害的责任转移给下游买方时社会福利达到峰值。这与 least cost avoider 原则一致，因为下游用户控制获取后的防护措施，最能高效降低风险。
brief.validation: 用田野调查决策规则约束智能体、用 LLM-DCE 恢复的偏好参数校准模型，但未说明与真实市场数据或历史案例的定量对比，仿真结论的可信度依赖这两类输入的质量。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的方法是把田野决策规则转译为 ABM 约束、用 LLM 做 DCE 恢复偏好参数的两阶段管线，以及并排比较不同法律制度福利效果的仿真设计。代码和数据未说明是否公开。

c15f7f2441e24011.text: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in simulating human-like social behaviors. Social graphs provide high-quality supervision signals that encode both local interactions and global network structure, yet they remain underutilized for LLM training. To address this gap, we propose Graphia, the first general LLM-based social graph simulation framework that leverages graph data as supervision for LLM post-training via reinforcement learning. With GNN-based structural rewards, Graphia trains specialized agents to predict whom to interact with (destination selection) and how to interact (edge generation), followed by designed graph generation pipelines. We evaluate Graphia under two settings: Transductive Dynamic Graph Generation (TDGG), a micro-level task with our proposed node-wise interaction alignment metrics; and Inductive Dynamic Graph Generation (IDGG), a macro-level task with our proposed metrics for aligning emergent network properties. On three real-world networks, Graphia improves micro-level alignment by 6.1% in the composite destination selection score, 12% in edge classification accuracy, and 27.9% in edge content BERTScore over the strongest baseline. For macro-level alignment, it achieves 35.98% higher structural similarity and 28.71% better replication of social phenomena such as power laws and echo chambers. Our results show that social graphs can serve as high-quality supervision signals for LLM post-training, closing the gap between agent behaviors and network dynamics for LLM-based simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ji-Cather/Graphia.git.
c15f7f2441e24011.abstract_zh: LLM 已能模拟类人的社会行为，但社交图数据里编码的局部互动和全局网络结构信息一直没被充分利用于 LLM 训练。作者提出 Graphia，第一个通用的基于 LLM 的社交图仿真框架，把图数据当作强化学习后训练的监督信号。框架用基于 GNN 的结构奖励，训练专门的智能体完成两件事：选择互动对象（destination selection）和生成互动内容（edge generation），再接上设计好的图生成流程。评测分两种设定：微观层面的 Transductive Dynamic Graph Generation（TDGG），配合作者提出的节点级互动对齐指标；宏观层面的 Inductive Dynamic Graph Generation（IDGG），配合作者提出的衡量涌现网络属性对齐程度的指标。在三个真实网络上，Graphia 相比最强基线，微观层面综合目的地选择分数提高 6.1%，边分类准确率提高 12%，边内容 BERTScore 提高 27.9%；宏观层面结构相似度提高 35.98%，对幂律、回音室等社会现象的复现改善 28.71%。结果表明社交图可以作为 LLM 后训练的高质量监督信号，缩小智能体行为与网络动态之间的差距。代码已开源。
c15f7f2441e24011.why: 它给出了一条把真实网络结构注入 LLM 智能体训练的可行路径，GNN 结构奖励加图数据后训练的做法可以直接搬到社会仿真和舆论传播类工作上，且在真实网络上验证了微观和宏观两层对齐。

brief.question: 现有 LLM 社会仿真没有充分利用社会图数据中编码的局部交互和全局网络结构信息，Graphia 要用图数据作为监督信号来增强 LLM 社会仿真。
brief.setup: Graphia 是一个基于 LLM 的社会图仿真框架，在三个真实世界网络上评估，未说明具体智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度。
brief.method: 用 GNN 生成的结构奖励（structural rewards）对 LLM 做强化学习后训练，训练专门的智能体预测与谁交互（destination selection）和如何交互（edge generation），再接图生成流水线。评估分两种设定：微观任务 TDGG（Transductive Dynamic Graph Generation）用节点级交互对齐指标，宏观任务 IDGG（Inductive Dynamic Graph Generation）用涌现网络性质对齐指标。
brief.findings: 在三个真实网络上，微观对齐比最强基线提升：复合 destination selection 分数提高 6.1%，边分类准确率提高 12%，边内容 BERTScore 提高 27.9%。宏观对齐上结构相似度提高 35.98%，对幂律和回音室等社会现象的复现改善 28.71%。
brief.validation: 与最强基线在三个真实世界网络上对比，用作者提出的节点级交互对齐指标和网络性质对齐指标衡量，未说明与真实人类行为数据的直接对比或消融细节。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: 代码开源在 https://github.com/Ji-Cather/Graphia.git，包括 GNN 结构奖励的 RL 后训练方法和 TDGG/IDGG 两套评估指标。

c8c418961fdad3e7.text: Understanding and replicating human mobility requires not only spatial-temporal accuracy but also an awareness of the cognitive hierarchy underlying real-world travel decisions. Traditional agent-based or deep learning models can reproduce statistical patterns of movement but fail to capture the semantic coherence and causal logic of human behavior. Large language models (LLMs) show potential, but struggle to balance creative reasoning with strict structural compliance. This study proposes a Hierarchical LLM-Agent Framework, termed Narrative-to-Action, that integrates high-level narrative reasoning, mid-level reflective planning, and low-level behavioral execution within a unified cognitive hierarchy. At the macro level, one agent is employed as a "creative writer" to produce diary-style narratives rich in motivation and context, then uses another agent as a "structural parser" to convert narratives into machine-readable plans. A dynamic execution module further grounds agents in geographic environments and enables adaptive behavioral adjustments guided by a novel occupation-aware metric, Mobility Entropy by Occupation (MEO), which captures heterogeneous schedule flexibility across different occupational personalities. At the micro level, the agent executes concrete actions-selecting locations, transportation modes, and time intervals-through interaction with an environmental simulation. By embedding this multi-layer cognitive process, the framework produces not only synthetic trajectories that align closely with real-world patterns but also interpretable representations of human decision logic. This research advances synthetic mobility generation from a data-driven paradigm to a cognition-driven simulation, providing a scalable pathway for understanding, predicting, and synthesizing complex urban mobility behaviors through hierarchical LLM agents.
c8c418961fdad3e7.abstract_zh: 理解和复现人类移动行为，除了时空准确性，还需要理解真实出行决策背后的认知层次。传统的基于智能体的模型和深度学习模型能复现移动的统计模式，但抓不住人类行为的语义连贯和因果逻辑。大语言模型有潜力，但难以在创造性推理和严格结构合规之间取得平衡。作者因此提出一个分层 LLM 智能体框架 Narrative-to-Action，把高层叙事推理、中层反思式规划和底层行为执行整合进统一的认知层级。宏观层面，一个智能体充当“创意写手”，生成富含动机和情境的日记式叙事；另一个智能体充当“结构解析器”，把叙事转成机器可读的计划。一个动态执行模块把智能体锚定在地理环境中，并根据一个新提出的职业感知指标 MEO（Mobility Entropy by Occupation）做自适应行为调整，该指标刻画不同职业人格在日程弹性上的差异。微观层面，智能体通过与环境仿真交互执行具体动作，包括选择地点、交通方式和时间间隔。作者称，嵌入这套多层认知过程后，框架生成的合成轨迹不仅与真实世界模式高度吻合，还提供了人类决策逻辑的可解释表示。作者认为这项工作把合成移动数据生成从数据驱动范式推进到认知驱动仿真，为理解、预测和合成复杂城市移动行为提供了一条可扩展路径。摘要未给出与真实数据对比的量化结果，也未说明实验设置。
c8c418961fdad3e7.why: 它给“用 LLM 生成出行轨迹”提供了一个可复用的三层认知架构（叙事、规划、执行），并提出了按职业刻画日程弹性的新指标 MEO，做城市移动仿真的人可以直接借鉴。

c91e4a2b5c41cd87.text: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are powering a growing share of interactive web applications, yet remain vulnerable to misuse and harm. Prior jailbreak research has largely focused on single-turn prompts, whereas real harassment often unfolds over multi-turn interactions. In this work, we present the Online Harassment Agentic Benchmark consisting of: (i) a synthetic multi-turn harassment conversation dataset, (ii) a multi-agent (e.g., harasser, victim) simulation informed by repeated game theory, (iii) three jailbreak methods attacking agents across memory, planning, and fine-tuning, and (iv) a mixed-methods evaluation framework. We utilize two prominent LLMs, LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct (open-source) and Gemini-2.0-flash (closed-source). Our results show that jailbreak tuning makes harassment nearly guaranteed with an attack success rate of 95.78--96.89% vs. 57.25--64.19% without tuning in Llama, and 99.33% vs. 98.46% without tuning in Gemini, while sharply reducing refusal rate to 1-2% in both models. The most prevalent toxic behaviors are Insult with 84.9--87.8% vs. 44.2--50.8% without tuning, and Flaming with 81.2--85.1% vs. 31.5--38.8% without tuning, indicating weaker guardrails compared to sensitive categories such as sexual or racial harassment. Qualitative evaluation further reveals that attacked agents reproduce human-like aggression profiles, such as Machiavellian/psychopathic patterns under planning, and narcissistic tendencies with memory. Counterintuitively, closed-source and open-source models exhibit distinct escalation trajectories across turns, with closed-source models showing significant vulnerability. Overall, our findings show that multi-turn and theory-grounded attacks not only succeed at high rates but also mimic human-like harassment dynamics, motivating the development of robust safety guardrails to ultimately keep online platforms safe and responsible.

cd7179b5c2f9fb19.text: A key challenge in transportation planning is that the collective preferences of heterogeneous travelers often diverge from the policies produced by model-driven decision tools. This misalignment frequently results in implementation delays or failures. Here, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs), noted for their capabilities in reasoning and simulating human decision-making, can help inform and address this alignment problem. We develop a multi-agent simulation in which LLMs, acting as agents representing residents from different communities in a city, participate in a referendum on a set of transit policy proposals. Using chain-of-thought reasoning, LLM agents provide ranked-choice or approval-based preferences, which are aggregated using instant-runoff voting (IRV) to model democratic consensus. We implement this simulation framework with both GPT-4o and Claude-3.5, and apply it for Chicago and Houston. Our findings suggest that LLM agents are capable of approximating plausible collective preferences and responding to local context, while also displaying model-specific behavioral biases and modest divergences from optimization-based benchmarks. These capabilities underscore both the promise and limitations of LLMs as tools for solving the alignment problem in transportation decision-making.
cd7179b5c2f9fb19.abstract_zh:
交通规划长期有个难题：模型驱动的决策工具给出的政策，往往和异质出行者的集体偏好不一致，这种错位常导致政策推迟实施或直接失败。作者提出用大语言模型来处理这个对齐问题，理由是 LLM 在推理和模拟人类决策上表现不错。

做法上，作者搭了一个多智能体仿真：LLM 智能体扮演一个城市里不同社区的居民，参加一场针对若干公交政策提案的公投。智能体用思维链推理，给出排序投票或赞成式偏好，再用即时决选制（IRV）汇总，以此模拟民主共识的形成。框架分别用 GPT-4o 和 Claude-3.5 实现，应用在芝加哥和休斯敦两个城市。

结果显示，LLM 智能体能近似出合理的集体偏好，也能对本地情境作出反应；同时不同模型表现出各自的行为偏差，与基于优化的基准结果有适度偏离。作者认为这既展示了 LLM 作为交通决策对齐工具的潜力，也暴露了它的局限。
cd7179b5c2f9fb19.why: 它把 LLM 智能体公投仿真直接用在真实城市的交通政策场景上，并对比了两个主流模型的行为偏差，对想用仿真预判政策民意、提前发现落地阻力的人是可参考的方法和反例。

brief.question: 交通规划中异质出行者的集体偏好常与模型驱动的决策工具产出的政策不一致，导致政策实施延迟或失败。研究推演 LLM 能否帮助解决这个对齐问题。
brief.setup: 多智能体仿真，LLM 智能体扮演城市中不同社区的居民，参与对一组交通政策提案的公投。框架用 GPT-4o 和 Claude-3.5 实现，应用于 Chicago 和 Houston 两个城市。时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: LLM 智能体用 chain-of-thought 推理给出排序选择（ranked-choice）或批准制（approval-based）偏好，再用即时决选投票（instant-runoff voting, IRV）聚合，模拟民主共识。
brief.findings: LLM 智能体能近似给出合理的集体偏好并对本地情境做出响应，同时表现出模型特有的行为偏差，与基于优化的基准结果有适度偏离。具体数字未说明。
brief.validation: 与基于优化的基准（optimization-based benchmarks）对比，发现存在适度偏离；未说明与真实投票或民调数据的对比。
brief.limits: LLM 智能体表现出模型特有的行为偏差，与优化基准有分歧；其他局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 仿真框架代码或数据是否公开未说明；可借鉴的方法是用 LLM 智能体加 chain-of-thought 生成偏好、再用 IRV 聚合的公投仿真流程。

cd177b8645612a0e.text: This research focuses on using large language models (LLMs) to simulate social experiments, exploring their ability to emulate human personality in virtual persona role-playing. The research develops an end-to-end evaluation framework, including individual-level analysis of stability and identifiability, as well as population-level analysis called progressive personality curves to examine the veracity and consistency of LLMs in simulating human personality. Methodologically, this research proposes important modifications to traditional psychometric approaches (CFA and construct validity) which are unable to capture improvement trends in LLMs at their current low-level simulation, potentially leading to remature rejection or methodological misalignment. The main contributions of this research are: proposing a systematic framework for LLM virtual personality evaluation; empirically demonstrating the critical role of persona detail in personality simulation quality; and identifying marginal utility effects of persona profiles, especially a Scaling Law in LLM personality simulation, offering operational evaluation metrics and a theoretical foundation for applying large language models in social science experiments.

c1b9fbd2cde58eb2.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) open new possibilities for constructing realistic and interpretable macroeconomic simulations. We present SimCity, a multi-agent framework that leverages LLMs to model an interpretable macroeconomic system with heterogeneous agents and rich interactions. Unlike classical equilibrium models that limit heterogeneity for tractability, or traditional agent-based models (ABMs) that rely on hand-crafted decision rules, SimCity enables flexible, adaptive behavior with transparent natural-language reasoning. Within SimCity, four core agent types (households, firms, a central bank, and a government) deliberate and participate in a frictional labor market, a heterogeneous goods market, and a financial market. Furthermore, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) determines the geographic placement of new firms and renders a mapped virtual city, allowing us to study both macroeconomic regularities and urban expansion dynamics within a unified environment. To evaluate the framework, we compile a checklist of canonical macroeconomic phenomena, including price elasticity of demand, Engel's Law, Okun's Law, the Phillips Curve, and the Beveridge Curve, and show that SimCity naturally reproduces these empirical patterns while remaining robust across simulation runs.

c3e83ff7286a1e0b.text: We present a comparative docking experiment that aligns human-subject interview data with large language model (LLM)-driven synthetic personas to evaluate fidelity, divergence, and blind spots in AI-enabled simulation. Fifteen early-stage startup founders were interviewed about their hopes and concerns regarding AI-powered validation, and the same protocol was replicated with AI-generated founder and investor personas. A structured thematic synthesis revealed four categories of outcomes: (1) Convergent themes - commitment-based demand signals, black-box trust barriers, and efficiency gains were consistently emphasized across both datasets; (2) Partial overlaps - founders worried about outliers being averaged away and the stress of real customer validation, while synthetic personas highlighted irrational blind spots and framed AI as a psychological buffer; (3) Human-only themes - relational and advocacy value from early customer engagement and skepticism toward moonshot markets; and (4) Synthetic-only themes - amplified false positives and trauma blind spots, where AI may overstate adoption potential by missing negative historical experiences. We interpret this comparative framework as evidence that LLM-driven personas constitute a form of hybrid social simulation: more linguistically expressive and adaptable than traditional rule-based agents, yet bounded by the absence of lived history and relational consequence. Rather than replacing empirical studies, we argue they function as a complementary simulation category - capable of extending hypothesis space, accelerating exploratory validation, and clarifying the boundaries of cognitive realism in computational social science.

cd2db2ca93f8c455.text: We introduce Traffic-R1, a 3B-parameter foundation model with human-like reasoning for Traffic signal control (TSC), developed via self-exploration and iterative reinforcement of LLM with expert guidance in a simulated traffic environment. Compared with traditional reinforcement learning and recent LLM-based methods, Traffic-R1 offers three main advantages: zero-shot generalization, transferring unchanged to new road networks and out-of-distribution incidents by leveraging internal traffic-control policies and reasoning; a compact 3B-parameter design that supports real-time inference on mobile-class chips for edge deployment; and an explainable TSC process that enables multi-intersection coordination through communication and an asynchronous communication network.
